title: finance.billing.invoice.paid
description: An invoice's allocations reached its total and it moved to `paid`, inside the payment's own transaction. `amount_paid_minor` is the cumulative amount allocated to it. `paid_date` is the settling payment's `received_date`.
$comment: Ahead of the producer (ADR-0020 slice I2): services/finance/app/services.py:record_payment does not emit currency, paid_date yet. Until that slice merges, a real payload fails this schema on exactly those fields. That is the forcing function, not a bug. Every other field is emitted today.
